title: Welcome to Odisha
text: Welcome to Odisha. Bhubaneswar is known as the temple city of India, famous for its ancient heritage and warm hospitality.

title: Lord Jagannath Temple
text: The sacred temple of Lord Jagannath is situated in the holy coastal city of Puri. Millions of devotees visit every year.

title: Opening Hours & Travel
text: The museum and library are open from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM from Tuesday through Sunday. Admission is free for children.

title: Directions & Weather
text: Please take the highway road towards Cuttack. The weather forecast predicts pleasant sunny skies with a light breeze.
